title: Studio UX audit: canvas whitespace, mobile layout, source-code page panel, and 2 rendering bugs
body:
## Summary

Browser walkthrough of the Studio design surface (`/studio/:packageId/*`) against the `com.example.showcase` fixture — desktop 1440×900 + mobile 390×844, light + dark. Tracking issue for the findings below; each will be fixed and checked off as the work lands.

Screenshots / full writeup: see session artifact (not linked here since it's a private Claude Code artifact — ping me if you want it re-shared).

## Findings

- [ ] **Bug — mobile card view renders `[object Object]` for lookup fields.** `Data pillar → Account → Records`, narrow viewport, card layout. The Owner lookup renders correctly ("Dev Admin") in the desktop grid but shows literal `[object Obje…]` in the mobile card view — the card formatter doesn't resolve the lookup's display value the way the grid formatter does.
- [ ] **Studio has no responsive/mobile layout.** At 390px the Objects tree stays fully expanded (not collapsed into a drawer), squeezing content into ~190px; the Data/Automations/Interfaces/Access pillar tabs get clipped off-screen with no way to reach the other three pillars.
- [ ] **Records tab has a ~100px empty band** between the sub-tab row (Records/Form/Validations/Settings) and the toolbar (Hide fields/Filter/Group/Sort), present on every object, every time. Worse on mobile — pushes the record list below the fold.
- [ ] **Validations tab doesn't default-select the first rule.** Even when rules exist, the detail pane shows "Select a rule on the left, or click 'New'...". Inconsistent with the Access pillar's Permission Set list, which does default-select the first item.
- [ ] **App Builder landing page (`/studio`) has a lot of dead space.** Content is confined to the top-left ~720×300 area; no card treatment for "create a package" the way Home's "Build an app / Start with a template" cards do it.
- [ ] **Automations flow canvas is mostly empty, and "fit view" doesn't fill it.** Every flow tested (including a "Parallel" one) is a 2–3 node single-column chain occupying a small corner of the canvas frame; there's also a large blank band below the frame unrelated to node content. The fit-view control only recenters/resets zoom (100%→96%) rather than scaling to fill.
- [ ] **HTML/React "source" authoring pages leave the right Properties panel permanently empty.** `Interfaces pillar → Authoring · HTML → Command Center` — since these pages are raw JSX/HTML (no selectable "block"), clicking the canvas never populates Properties; it's stuck on "Click a block on the canvas...". Suggestion: show a read-only, syntax-highlighted source view there instead for `Authoring · HTML` / `Authoring · React` page types.
- [ ] **Permission matrix column headers (C R U D Tr Re Pu VA MA) have no legend/tooltip** on the Access pillar, making the less obvious abbreviations (Tr/Re/Pu/VA/MA) hard to decode for first-time users.

## Bonus (found incidentally, same Command Center page)

- [ ] "Weekly Throughput" widget is permanently stuck on "Loading…".
- [ ] KPI cards (Open Tasks / Completed / Cycle Time) are too narrow — labels and numbers get clipped/wrapped ("Completed" → "Complete", "1,902" wraps mid-number).

## What's already good (no action needed)

Dark mode is consistent throughout; the inline "new package" creation form is low-friction; Automations canvas and Interfaces WYSIWYG are otherwise polished. The `#2283` "Open app" 404 fix was also re-verified end-to-end during this pass.
